firstRunNotice.title: Welcome to SwitchForge
firstRunNotice.bodyDefault: SwitchForge lets you switch between Claude Code and Codex providers with a single click. Existing live configurations can be imported as a provider so your settings remain available.
firstRunNotice.bodyOfficial: An “Official” preset is also included in the list — click it any time you want to switch back to the official default. SwitchForge automatically backs up your current config to “default” before switching, so you can move back and forth freely. That's how SwitchForge works 😊
